notes.title: Cardiac Event Recorder - Update #49 - And Roadmap!
notes.content:
Hello it's me, Angel!

This update mainly sets up story mode to handle all those final bosses that are just waiting to be added! There is also finally a stat page to view all the numbers the game has been tracking!

[b][u]Early Access updated game version to v7.1[/u][/b]

[h2]Content Added -[/h2]
[list]
    [*]New branching path choice at the end of a story run if any alternate final bosses are unlocked
    [*]Each story path has new types of medals to earn
    [*]Added a stats page in the main hub where you can watch all your numbers go up
[/list]
[h2]Updates and tweaks -[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Some tracked story records had to be reset due to the new story path structure (this will not affect any dream progress)
    [*]Changed the file completion percentage to exclude all medals that are beyond the scope of any dreams (A new marker will be added to denote completion of these soon)
    [*]Adjusted the amount of blessing generated in the radiant garden
    [*]The amount of blessing generated by each action will diminish as you do more in a single visit
    [*]Added an upgrade to the garden that allows you to overpay for a gift and fill the blessing bar more
    [*]Upgrading the garden will now also fill the blessing based on amount of tetrids spent
    [*]Set a limit on donations to Blot's Gallery per visit
    [*]Added an upgrade to Blot's Gallery to allow her to accept up to 5 donations
    [*]Tagged more gifts as "art" for Blot's gallery
    [*]Solara's shop event will not end if you buy all the gifts, allowing you to check upgrades before leaving
    [*]All events that have upgrades will now show an alert icon if you can afford any upgrade
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes -[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug where the Quickplay equip menu could incorrectly show that panics are equipped when they weren't
[/list]


[h1]Future Roadmap![/h1]

It's time to spill the hearts on what exactly I have left to do in order to be able to call this game finally finished!

[h2]New Monsters[/h2]
First Lets review the list of 8 missing normal monsters:
[list]
[*]Shanx (Guardian)
[*]Alter Shanx (Guardian)
[*]Guardian Soul (Guardian)
[*]Dendrohai (Glyph)
[*]Chionotoh (Glyph)
[*]Ventra (Zaramech)
[*]Veyeral Quartet (Veyeral)
[*]Storm Veyeral (Veyeral)
[/list]
The newest monster, Shy Momo, was also on this list the last time I posted it. This means that now all the Shambles and Glass Flora are done! (The normal, non-final bossy ones anyways ːveyeralː)

I'm going to keep the amount of final bosses a secret until the big day when they are all put in, but I will say that there is at least one per category!

[h2]New Monster Events[/h2]
There will be one other shop type event similar to Blot's Gallery. The catch is that only one of these can appear per run. The first one you fight will be the one who opens their shop.

There is also another type of event planned! They will be gift trading events with several of the monsters. Each monster will offer different types of gifts and different amounts of them. They will each have their own quirks about what and how they want to trade. None of these will have any type of upgrades or anything like that as there will be several of them.

Only one of these events will appear per run and they will only happen at the end of a three battle chapter. If multiple trading monsters have been defeated, it will pick one of them randomly.

There may be other limits placed on amount of events that can appear per run. We will see how the balance feels.

[h2]Altered Story Extended Event[/h2]
An event will be added to Altered Story mode that will take place just after the "Altered Nowhere" chapter. It will allow you to extend the run by up to 3 extra battles! But you will have to make sacrifices such as giving up gifts or panics to make the rest of the run harder. This event will also not appear if you took any gifts from the link synapse at the start.

This will be the ultimate challenge to earn the biggest score possible!

[h2]New Music[/h2]
As I worked on the music for all of those secret final bosses, I made many many drafts. I cut lots of cool Ideas that didn't quite fit. Lots of cool ideas that you will never ever get to hear...

OR! I can put all those cool ideas into a 3rd set of songs for each monster family! What's that? Three whole songs for each monster group is not enough? Wouldn't you know it, I went ahead and made a 4th set of songs for them too!

But I can't just use all these songs just anywhere. No, monsters need special occasions to pull these out. So you're going to have to be a little patient as I get those special occasions ready.

[h2]The Towers[/h2]
A new game mode where you must climb a tower while only battling monsters of a specific type. There will be 6 of these towers to unlock, one for each of the monster families. There will also be some surprises in each tower, that I won't go into just yet.

Unlocking each tower will have something to do with the newborn monsters. Reaching a certain goal in all 6 of these towers will also be the true way of unlocking Endless Nightmare!

[h2]Ultimate Tower[/h2]
The final challenge! Can you climb a massive tower while battling every single monster in the game?
I won't give away all the mechanics of this yet, but heartbreak will not necessarily mean starting over from the bottom. But I'm sure some of you will be able to do it in 1 life!

[h2]Story[/h2]
This update just added the "Choose Her Path" event. This will always come right before the "Nowhere" chapter that currently sits at the end of every story run. Each of the 4 characters can choose which of the 3 available final bosses to fight. If you look closely, you will notice that each path says it contains "1 battle," but that's not always going to be the case!

All characters will have several paths to choose from and different amounts of battles in each. Some paths will even have whole extra chapters like the one in Altered Story mode. Each heart will also have battles with final bosses that others will never meet in their story. And of course, each of these paths will have ending scenes!

Altered Story is where all characters be able to battle every single final bosses in a story-like run.

[h2]Fifth Character[/h2]
This character has still not been added for a very simple reason, she will unlock when all the other characters advance to a certain point in their stories, but those stories aren't done yet. She would be somewhat of a spoiler if I add her too soon. Especially for the few of you who are too good at piecing things together with those gift memories!

I have confirmed that she will be some sort of helper based character. And yes, she will also have an alter.

[h2]New Gifts[/h2]
Everything above is set in stone, but this is the most tenuous section.

Most of my gift ideas are already done, but there are a few more that will be sprinkled into updates along the way. I still need to do that Toxic Aura gift.

I'm still deciding if I want to add the starting effects of the alter characters as some sort of cursed gift. A set of gifts with big gains, but also big drawbacks. If I do add these "cursed gifts," they will be added in a way that makes them completely avoidable at all times. They would also definitely be called something other than "cursed gifts."

There is also another type of gift that I've always had in the plans, but they may be cut depending on how hard they are to implement. They would be used immediately in the battle where they are offered and wear off after. Sort of like an auto quick gift, but it's used before the battle and not received at the end.

The effects of these wouldn't be direct buffs, but rather they would create objects to shoot during the battle that would trigger some effects. Like pop them for karma, pop them to create a small panic in place, stuff like that. They would also hold the combo while you try to break them. It's almost as if the monster is using these gifts to attack, but you know they secretly want you to win.

[h2]Timeline[/h2]
I will not make any promises on how long any of these will take, but I can give an outline on what order I plan to finish these.

[h3]Early Access v7.X[/h3]
First, I will finish all the events including the big Altered Story one. These will be spread out over a few updates. I will also be adding a few of the missing monsters including the newborn, Guardian Soul.

I don't expect this to take very long compared to the other main versions.

[h3]Early Access v8.X[/h3]
With all 6 newborn monsters done, I can finish up "The Towers" mode and advance up to version 8.0. This will also be where I add in the 12 new battle songs! All the remaining common bosses will be added here as well.

After that, I can work on all the remaining final bosses.
Expect a long wait between the last v8.X and v9.0.

[h3]Early Access v9.X[/h3]
Once all the story scenes and final bosses are ready. It's time for a BIG update that will have ALMOST all the story and ALMOST every final boss. This is where playable heart number 5 will be added too! There will only be one last thing to tackle.

[h1]v1.0![/h1]
Adding The Ultimate Tower will finally take this up to v1.0! The Early Access tag will finally be removed!

[h2]One Last Gift![/h2]
I recently posted a sneak peak at one of the future final boss battle themes. It's right here if you want to listen!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H5yMMKZaubE

Thank you all for continuing to support me in this madness!

notes.title: Devtober 2021 Summary and Future Plans
notes.content:
Hi, it's me Angel Polanco, like the one from the credit screen! Another successful year of devtober! One update for all umm... 32 days of October! And they were all on time this year despite my internet being down for almost a whole day at one point.

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
[list]
 [*]6 new monsters to love! (Total: 81)
 [*]15 new Power Gifts (Total: 198)
 [*]3 new Bonus Gifts (Total: 60)
 [*]1 new Quick Gift (Total: 56)
 [*]7 new Dreamscapes (Total: 29)
 [*]17 new dreams to fulfill (Total: 475)
 [*]2 new types of gift challenges
[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Rebalanced the effects of several gifts (Especially Auras and a few 3 star gifts)
 [*]Shuffled around a bunch of rewards from dreams
 [*]A bunch of other bug fixes and small tweaks
[/list]

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]

The monster goal has been set at 80 for a while and we just passed it, so now what's left?

Five of the Six monsters added during devtober were not planned to exist at all. They were each created within 2 or 3 days thanks to the mindset that this kind of challenge puts me in. They were all essentially alters that reused a lot of code from other battles. Voladrome is the only exception as she has been planned for years now. I chose to make her for devtober because she would be the fastest remaining guardian to make, and they've had the fewest battles for a long time.

With the addition of these new devtober battles, there will now be 13 "common" monsters for every category, except Veyerals and Specials. Veyerals will only have 12, but they will also have the most Final Battles.

I posted the names of the remaining 9 monsters in the discord just before devtober, but the spirit of devtober took over my body and added 6 more while I wasn't looking!

With Voladrome done and Alter Shanx now added to the list, these are the 9 remaining common monsters:
[list]
[*]Shanx (Guardian)
[*]Alter Shanx (Guardian)
[*]Guardian Soul (Guardian)
[*]Dendrohai (Glyph)
[*]Chionotoh (Glyph)
[*]Ventra (Zaramech)
[*]Shy Momo (Glass Flora)
[*]Veyeral Quartet (Veyeral)
[*]Storm Veyeral (Veyeral)
[*]There is also a top secret amount of Final Battles left
[/list]

Okay, so you all know me by now. You know I can't keep my hands off the dang update button! So this is what I'm going to do. I'll keep on working on the secret story stuff, but every once in a while, I'll make a few of these remaining common monsters and release them as an update. Once all 9 of these are out, you will know that I am finally, for really real, close to finishing this game!

[h1]Other Work[/h1]
Another thing to note is that I also work with team Moonana on some of their games. I worked on "Virgo Vs The Zodiac" and I'm working on their new game, "Keylocker." It just had a very successful Kickstarter and a we've also released a demo on steam! Please check those out as well!

sometimes, I have to take days or weeks off from Void Rains to help them out instead. This has and will continue to affect the release of this game, but it also keeps me from burning out on a single project for years.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/920320/Virgo_Versus_The_Zodiac/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325040/Keylocker__Turn_Based_Cyberpunk_Action/

[h1]Discord[/h1]
I'm always talking about future plans and such in the Veyeral Games discord. So many of the quality of life changes have come from the lovely people in this server. They even convinced me to make Split Veyeral hold the combo, so I think they deserve at least some of the blame for v1.0 taking years to finish. Join us and throw me all your ideas so that I never actually finish this game!
https://discord.gg/frFeep576y

Thank you so much for showing these monsters love!
It means the world to me!
ːradiantheartː ːveyeralː

notes.title: Cardiac Event Recorder - Update #33
notes.content:
Heya Voids and Voidettes!

Kitty Skies reporting once again from this great cosmos! Your favorite Kitty is here to tell you that a new update has indeed gone live!

The first major part of this update is a change to the HUD and new score indicators. We’ve made a real effort to improve visuals and categories in the dreams, monsters and gifts menu. We hope you enjoy these improvements as much as we do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31869030/aaf9180cafc07b91334350d39b0501ac2e9ad96c.gif[/img]

The second major part of this update is built around the community feedback. Having a panic attack after a situation has passed is no good and thanks to community member Hybban, we have now prevented this from happening after bosses are loved, meaning you get to save those precious panic attacks for your next love encounter with our wonderful monsters. 

A handful of other changes in this update were also made because of feedback from Thultex and Seyon. We take all feedback seriously and want The Void Rains Upon Her Heart to be the best it can be. Please keep it coming in! Thank you so much for the submissions. All you have to do is post in the comment section below or in the forums and we will take everything into consideration.

Flashback to October 2018, Veyerals did a challenge which saw him add a new piece of content to the game every day throughout the month. We are glad to announce that October 2019 the same will be happening. You can expect updates daily throughout October if he succeeds in his challenge, else he will be tossed into the Void forever! 

As always, the full patch notes will be posted below and we hope to see you lighting up voids very shortly.

As a reminder: 

[h1]The next update will be due on 30th November 2019.*[/h1]

Here’s the full list of changes we’ve made-

[b][u]Early Access updated game version v4.6 -> v4.7[/u][/b]

[h1]Content Added -[/h1]
[list]
    [*]1 new blue gift to unlock (Total: 123).
    [*]Smoother analog movement for gamepad controls.
    [*]New HUD design.
    [*]New score indicators that appear along with each burst of motes.
    [*]New groups in the dreams menu that highlight dreams with specific types of unlock rewards.
    [*]New groups in the monsters and gifts menus that hold cards that are ready to radiate.
    [*]Added a warning before the title screen if the game detects an unusual frame rate.
[/list]
[h1]Updates and tweaks -[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Releasing a charge attack early will instantly fire a normal bullet instead of nothing.
    [*]Roundsaw holds the combo during certain attacks.
    [*]Veyeral Rain's raining attack is slightly reduced during phase 2 for all versions below level 10.
    [*]The Puncture gift has been changed to affect all basic shot types including feather shots.
    [*]Love Signals can be canceled by pressing the charge button again.
    [*]Changed the effect of Sine Wave on a single stream of bullets.
    [*]Focus can now be used to reduce the spread of splitting heart shots.
    [*]Panic attacks can't be used after the boss is defeated to prevent accidentally wasting them.
    [*]The dream required to unlock the 3rd character has been changed (They will stay unlocked if you had already unlocked them).
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes -[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug where there was a small delay on becoming immune when using a panic attack.
    [*]Fixed a bug where breaking Vitrea's petals would spawn the debris somewhere offscreen.
[/list]
[h1]Coming soon -[/h1]
[list]
    [*]October daily update challenge. Can Veyerals add a new piece of content per day for October?!
[/list]

Coldest Wishes,
The Void

ːawooː

notes.title: Cardiac Event Recorder - Update #31 - Thirty eight monsters to love in total!

Heya Voids and Voidettes!

Another month, another update! 

In this update we’ve added a new powerful final boss to love! This means now, there are 38 monsters in the game to love. I still remember playing the Alpha when there were only around about 8 monsters, I’m so proud of how far Veyerals (the dev) and The Void Rains Upon Her Heart has come. There’s also the fact that dreams can come true, that’s why we’ve also added nine new dreams too raising the total to an impressive 257 dreams to fulfill. 

A lot of moving from version 4.4 to 4.5 was updating and tweaking systems. If you like or disagree with any additions or changes please do post below or in the forums and we’ll respond to you in a timely manner. The full log as always is below containing every change.

Thank you and I look forward to posting another wonderful update next month.

As a reminder:

Here’s the full list of changes we’ve made-

    [*]9 new Dreams to fulfill (Total: 257).
[/list]

[list]

notes.title: Cardiac Event Recorder - Update #30 - This artist was great, they could always draw a crowd
notes.content:
Heya Voids and Voidettes!

My deepest apologies for the delay in the update notes. I’ve been ill and under the (heatwave) weather. The good news however is that the update has been live for a few days now.

So let’s start this update blog: This week marked the beginning of the summer sale and we’ve entered with a huge whopping 40% discount on The Void Rains Upon Her Heart. notes.title: International hug a Veyeral day!
notes.content:
I would like to take a moment of our time to wish the most wonderful Veyerals a very happy birthday. Today shall be forever known as international hug a Veyeral day and I wanted to add a gift and small message from the inspiration I've gained.

Since me and Veyerals met, he’s shown me nothing but kindness, determination, reliability and has deeply inspired me to greater heights by his burning passion and commitment alone. Not only is he an amazing business partner but I’ve also found a very close and dear friend. Veyerals is simply amazing and I wanted to do something really special for him and as a community I hope we can all spam happy birthday in the comments and give him gifts to show just how amazing he is.

For my gift, I reached out to my friend, Castwee, to ask if he could fulfil what was in my mind. Without hesitation I was assisted and thus this was produced:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31869030/5696b5978c929a92bdfd47158911594e9b8183b7.png[/img]

Friends are a very important factor in life, and in the game I feel this message is strongly portrayed as well as other issues, emotions and factors which I can highly relate to. Depression, anxiety and suicide are always difficult to address, especially through mediums where we try to escape them. There are no real and easy solutions to these problems but something which really helped me was realising that we are never alone and there’s always someone there to listen to you. A big part of me getting this far has been because of amazing friends like Veyerals, a wonderful fanbase and a strong community. I cannot thank everyone enough for this.

The Void Rains Upon Our Heart has done way better than we could ever imagine and from the bottom of my heart and on behalf of Veyerals, we thank you so much. I would also like you to know that me and Veyerals are always here to listen if you ever need to reach out to us.

 Thank you so much Veyerals and hope you have a wonderful day. :nekoheart:

notes.title: Steam may have flagged Wandersong and others as fake for months
notes.content:
Valve’s attempts to identify ‘fake’ games on Steam through automated metrics may have backfired, hurting the developers of some excellent games in the process. As brought up by Wandersong developer Greg Lobanov on Twitter yesterday, the well-reviewed, multi-award-winning game was flagged as an unknown quantity on the store. Until Steam somehow learnt more about the game through users interactions with it, it wouldn’t be eligible for full Steam store perks such as offering trading cards, but nothing seemed to be budging even months after launch.

After raising awareness of the issue on Twitter, Lobanov has since been contacted directly by Valve, who say that this was a bug that Wandersong and “many other games” were permanently restricted by, and that the problem is only now being addressed five months later. Wandersong is now free of restrictions, some other games appear stuck in this bizarre ‘not quite real’ limbo state.

notes.title: Cardiac Event Recorder - Update #14 - New difficulties!
notes.content:
Heya my lovelies!

This update is a particularly major one which sees The Void Rains Upon Her Heart evolve from version 2.3 to 3.0!

Those seeking new challenges or easier monsters to love will be appeased to know we’ve added TWO new difficulties; Mist Rain and Torrent Rain!!

The first is particularly good, because it allows me to use the “I tried to catch some fog, but I mist” pun.

CricketSounds.mp3 *Ahem*......... 

Mist Rain difficulty is the lowest difficulty which is targeted at newcomers and beginners of the genre. The monsters range from level 1-6 and have a new feature implemented called debuffs.

What this means is that the monsters on Mist Difficulty will have three random downgrades: attack down, speed down and health down. 

This is great to us as the game can now be enjoyed by even more gamers from all skill backgrounds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31869030/552a4fe3493e041215dd88eb03e3586af3847174.gif[/img]

And of course, talking of skills, the long awaited Torrent difficulty is here too. This blistering difficulty turns the temperature up and overloads some of the monsters. Monsters start from level 7 and go all the way up to 15.  

Overloaded monsters will come with three random buffs and like the debuffs can range from attack up, speed up, health up!

We’ve also added some sweet new effects! Charged shots use more effects from normal bullets now including the effects granted by Sine Wave, Anchor, and Multi-Shot gifts

Take a look at this gif below showing it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31869030/74c6284f7922b016ccb854a47d14d25f452ed7c2.gif[/img]

Heya Voids and Voidettes,

Hope you all had a great summer sale and welcome aboard all of you new purchasers! 

For some of you, this’ll be your first update and to keep you in the loop, every two weeks we update the game and constantly add new content and keep them in handy logs throughout these update posts.

For this update, it’s all about alternatives. This week sees four monsters being added for you to love. Three of these battles added this week are alternate forms of current monsters, while the fourth is well a new monster and quite frankly… a secret. ;-)

Thanks to an extremely helpful member of our community we have fixed a bug in the Nix Polyps battle. Something to do with lasers. FIRING MAH LAZER. PEW. PEW. PEW!

Ahem… anyway… All of your feedback is extremely important and really helps make the void the best it can be. We are super appreciative of your help so far and together we will make the void great again.

Here’s the full list of changes we’ve made-

[h1]We will post updates bi-weekly, Thursdays at 1PM PST / 4PM EST / 9PM GMT / 10PM CET.[/h1]

This week we see a plethora of updates, mostly originating from our players’ valuable feedback, and full combo hunters will be relieved to hear that we are doing a slight alteration of the combo system in order to allow players to full combo all bosses. We are also adding Steam cloud saves to backup your valuable save files after one player lost their saves — we never want anyone else to have to experience losing their love to the void! 


Here’s the full list of changes we’ve made-

[b][u]Early Access updated game version 1.0b to 1.1[/u][/b]

[h1]Content Added -[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Soundtrack DLC.
    [*]Cloud Saves.
    [*]Four Unique Save Slots.
[/list]
[h1]Updates -[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Roundsaw holds a combo when her eye is off screen.
    [*]Sandrome holds a combo when her head is off screen.
    [*]Scrambla/Boiler can not be pushed off screen.
    [*]Combo Challenges for several monsters in Story mode have been adjusted.
    [*]Quickplay medal goals for several monsters have been raised. (Some of your medals may have been downgraded!)
    [*]The Window Size display option now shows the actual dimensions of the window.
    [*]You can now press the "Accept" button to speed up the battle results screens.
    [*]You can now press the "Back/Cancel" button to skip any scene you have already seen (AKA skip the ending scenes).
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes -[/h1]
[list]
    [*]None needed!
[/list]
[h1]Coming soon -[/h1]
[list]
    [*]A new Eyeric Glyph monster. 
    [*]New scenes for Defect in Story Mode, including her true ending. 
    [*]A few new gifts.
[/list]

Coldest Wishes,
The Void

:awoo:

notes.title: Attention all players - Tetrid System Explained!
notes.content:
We’ve already received a lot of feedback and from watching many streams and videos we’ve noticed a lot of players are missing out on one of this game’s key features. 

Thanks to this invaluable feedback, we will be updating the game shortly to add a better tutorial for this section of the game, but until then we will explain it in this post.

After beating each monster fight, you are presented with this screen which shows the “Tetrids” that you have earned..

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31869030/f3f4493f17b67c7841089dcacb7a1f50b40a5949.png[/img]

What these Tetrids allow you to do is permanently reveal monsters and gifts by ‘Radiating’ them. You have access to this from the Main Menu in the “Monsters” and “Gifts” sub-menus.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31869030/47a46190f9a9dd6ef4a49843014156e736dc8483.png[/img]

Radiating a monster will unlock the ability to face that monster in Quickplay and reveal additional information about her, including her strengths and weaknesses..

Radiating a Gift will permanently reveal it in Story Mode, so in future playthroughs, you will see that Gift if it is available as a reward from a monster, giving you more information in order to decide which monster to face next.. It also unlocks the Gift for use in Quickplay mode.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31869030/0e58222b34c131738fa4b02b721d26b4c63b9c58.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31869030/aa9c7a6c89082a7b9af563abab95b466b306e1e4.png[/img]

This part of the game I feel is very important to know as I really do enjoy collecting and unlocking all the gifts and monsters, as well as reading all of their descriptions.

Hope this post helps. Early Access is essential to this title so we can continue taking in feedback and making it the best game it can be, and we are very excited to be releasing the game into Early Access today at 1PM Eastern/6PM GMT!

If you have any other questions or need help, our discord doors are open. Come say hello!
https://discord.gg/pUv9q9y 

Happy Valentines Day,

Love,
Kitty.

notes.title: The Hidden Levels – A new publisher revealed
notes.content:
Hello world and fans alike, this is Kitty from The Hidden Levels. I’m very excited to be presenting to you our first-ever announcement, from our first-ever published game. In this announcement I would like to tell you more about the history of The Hidden Levels, our journey thus far, and our aims into the future beyond.

We started in August 2015 as a media outlet focused on streaming and creating YouTube videos to help promote video games for Xbox One and Steam. These videos and streams, which continue running to this day, give a lot of free publicity and attention to new developers and publishers who are striving to be noticed among the onslaught of game releases every month. With each piece of coverage we remain even-handed but outspoken, to make sure the audience and fans are fully informed about the good and the bad.
 
In 2016, we started to branch out into public relations, helping out smaller developers with marketing advice, distribution and support. We wanted to reach out to help new developers who are just as passionate and dedicated to gaming as us. We found ourselves in the crucial role of helping developers who had very little or even zero support in this behemoth of an industry.
 
Now, in 2018, we are actually publishing video games while supporting other developers and publishers in the industry, as that's truly where our passion lies. We have no competition, only role models, icons, and friends who we do our very best for. We want great things to happen to ourselves and all those around us.

We also have one more game scheduled for 2018:
Maiden City The Last Collateral Damage - It's store page will be up soon!

If you would like to follow us to keep updated with all of our reviews, videos and products here are all the links you will need!
 
Website: http://www.thehiddenlevels.com  
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/thehiddenlevels 
Mixer: https://mixer.com/thehiddenlevels
Discord: https://discord.gg/pUv9q9y 
Twitter: https://www.twitter.com/thehiddenlevels 

Steam Group: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/thehiddenlevels 
Steam Curator: http://store.steampowered.com/curator/10773262/

Thank you for your time, I really appreciate it!

Warmest Regards,
Kitty
